prompt_text: What are the best vacation rentals in Santa Cruz County California and how do I pick one?
ai_overview_text:
The best vacation rentals in Santa Cruz County range from beachfront cottages in Capitola and Pleasure Point to secluded redwoods retreats in the mountains, with average nightly rates spanning $89 to $884+ per night (peaking around $530/night in July and dropping to an average of $389/night in November). HomeToGo | Vacation Rentals +3
The Boardwalk Haven: Modern, clean, and highly rated (~9.8/10), putting you close to the Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk and Westside surf spots. Homes & Villas by Marriott Bonvoy +1
Harbor House A: Overlooks Santa Cruz Harbor (~9.0/10) with steps to the water.
Pebble at Sunny Cove & Modern Oasis (via Kendall & Potter): Great for families and groups near Seabright and Sunny Cove.
Pleasure Point Rentals: Ideal for surfers, featuring garage surfboard storage and decks overlooking Monterey Bay. Kendall & Potter +2
Brand New Luxury Capitola Village Home: Rated ~9.4/10, offering walkability to Capitola's colorful waterfront, shops, and restaurants. Kendall & Potter +2
Fern River Resort (Felton): Scenic redwoods setting with creekside cabins (~9.2/10), ideal for a quiet forest escape near Henry Cowell Redwoods. Expedia +1
Santa Cruz (Boardwalk / Westside / Eastside): Best for energy, amusement parks, wharf sea lions, and surf culture (Steamer Lane, Pleasure Point).
Capitola: Best for a colorful, strollable village feel with sandy beaches and boutique dining.
Aptos / La Selva Beach / Watsonville: Quieter coastal neighborhoods with family-friendly beaches like Seacliff and Rio Del Mar.
The Redwoods (Felton / Boulder Creek): Cooler, forest-shaded retreats if you prefer hiking and trees over the ocean breeze. Visit Santa Cruz County +3
Pet-Friendly: Essential if bringing a dog (look at platforms like Vrbo or local managers like Kendall & Potter which feature designated pet-friendly homes).
Outdoor Space: Check for hot tubs, BBQ areas, or surfboard/bike storage if you plan on active beach days.
Work-from-Home: Verify high-speed Wi-Fi availability if you are mixing remote work with vacation. Vrbo +3
Peak Season (June–August): Highest demand and highest prices (averaging over $530/night). Book several months in advance.
Shoulder/Off-Peak (September–May): October offers high availability, and winter months (December–February) feature lower rates and weekly/monthly stay discounts (often 10–19% off). HomeToGo | Vacation Rentals +1
Use aggregators like HomeToGo or Vrbo, or local property managers like Kendall & Potter and Beachnest for personalized local support. Marriott members can also look at Marriott Homes & Villas to earn or redeem points. Beachnest Vacation Rentals +4
If you tell me how many guests are traveling, your budget per night, and whether you prefer the beach or the redwoods, I can recommend specific properties for your dates.
